response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS a FROM orderexecutions WHERE fillcount IS NOT NULL AND fillcount <> 0 GROUP BY ordersmark), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM per), k1 AS (SELECT per.ordersmark, per.a AS a, per.a - b1.m AS e1 FROM per, b1 WHERE per.a > b1.m), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m2 FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.a AS a, k1.e1 AS e1, k1.a - b2.m2 AS e2 FROM k1, b2 WHERE k1.a > b2.m2) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_fill_quantity, AVG(e1) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(e2) AS avg_second_excess FROM k2
